title: ChatGPT's business agent active users exceeded 40 million. This is a seven-fold increase in three months
key_facts: Thibaut Sotio, head of OpenAI product, said on 7 Oct 2026 (local time) that Codex and ChatGPT Work together had 40 million weekly active users, an all-time high.
Codex is a coding agent and ChatGPT Work a general task agent; ChatGPT Work launched on 9 July 2026.
The article says Codex had about 500,000 weekly users at the start of the year and that ChatGPT overall passed 1 billion weekly users in August.
According to OpenAI, about 20% of Codex users were non-developers in June; the article says that user base grew more than three times faster than developers.
The article's own numbers do not line up: it also says 6 million people used Codex and Work since 9 July, which does not match 40 million.
The 'seven-fold increase in three months' appears in the headline and subheading only; the body does not state it.
quote_evidence: Thibaut Sotio, head of OpenAI product, said on the 7th (local time) that Codex and ChatGPT Walk had 40 million weekly active users (WAU) on the same day.
According to OpenAI, about 20% of Codex users were non-developers in June, and the user base grew more than three times faster than developers.
why_it_matters_hint: Agents are moving into office and data work; the figures are the company's own and do not fully agree within the article.
notes: Full article read (Maeil Business Newspaper, English page). The article spells 'ChatGPT Walk' once (read as ChatGPT Work). The headline credits the 40 million to the 'business agent' alone, but the body credits Codex and ChatGPT Work together. Score lowered 6 to 5 for the overstated headline.
